scope: Synthetic isolated publisher with PostgreSQL SQL adapter; no live model activation, no authorization inferred from fixture approval

checks.name: repeat publication stages exactly one immutable row per logical key
run artifact cannot be reused with different bytes
same point key cannot silently replace prediction evidence
same evaluation key cannot silently replace evaluation evidence
ambiguous active channel refuses pointer update

limitations: Spark three-part schema replaced by local PostgreSQL schema. String/date fields use text in fixture. UTF-8 decode(unhex(...)) and current_timestamp() are mapped to PostgreSQL equivalents; explicit casts reproduce Spark assignment coercion for numerical columns.
No Delta concurrency, warehouse jobs, permissions, storage retention, PostgREST or live model activation checked.
